errors.text_span: като част от изследване на въздействието на маркетинговата синергия върху резултатите на новите продукти
errors.evidence: This phrase introduces context from the paper's title, which is external metadata and not part of the figure itself. The figure's own title is sufficient to describe its purpose.

The description fails to mention that neither the category axis (vertical) nor the value axis (horizontal) has an axis label. It also omits that the horizontal axis lacks a visible scale with tick marks.
